outcome: Accuracy of the RCOG risk assessment model (RAM) in predicting postpartum VTE
Association of biomarkers with postpartum VTE
cohort: 146 women with VTE and 413 women without VTE who underwent imaging for suspected postpartum VTE at Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital from January 2019 to December 2021
finding: The RCOG RAM alone was not an effective predictor of postpartum VTE in Chinese women, but its accuracy improved when combined with biomarkers such as LDL, D-dimer, and WBC count.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with postpartum VTE in the low-RCOG-score group.
